LLM auditresponse for PKGBUILD:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This PKGBUILD follows standard Arch Linux packaging conventions. It downloads a prebuilt .deb file from the project's own GitHub releases URL (https://github.com/Polyfrost/OneLauncher/releases/download/...), which is consistent with the package's stated purpose as a prebuilt Minecraft launcher. The source URL is the upstream project's own repository, and the file includes a specific SHA256 checksum (not SKIP) to verify the downloaded .deb.

The package() function uses bsdtar to extract the .deb archive and its contents into $pkgdir, then cleans up temporary Debian packaging artifacts (debian-binary, control.tar.*, data.tar.*). It creates a relative symlink from oneclient_app to $pkgdir/usr/bin/oneclient, which is standard practice for packages where the installed binary has a different name than the package command. No operations occur outside $pkgdir.

No suspicious indicators were found: no network requests beyond the declared upstream source, no use of eval/base64/curl/wget, no obfuscated code, no execution of fetched content, and no modification of system files outside the package directory.
</details>
